E1.title: Periodic Messaging
E1.why: Enables sending repeated messages at set intervals, filling the gap for timed notifications
E1.what: Adds a repeat block to schedule side‑effect actions (e.g., telegram) every N seconds for a given count
E1.risk: May be misused for spamming if not rate‑limited
E1.block_doc: repeat(action, interval_seconds, count) -> executes the given side‑effect action repeatedly
E1.source: request I couldn't do yet: Let's suppose say me hi every 1 second for next 5 seconds
E1.note: replaced by the universal code block in v0.4

E2.title: 3D Website Builder
E2.why: Enables users to generate interactive 3D web pages using Three.js without external services.
E2.what: Adds a block that compiles HTML/JS with Three.js scenes from given assets and returns a hosted URL.
E2.risk: Potentially heavy compute and storage usage.
E2.block_doc: threejs_build(template_url:str, assets:list, config:dict=None) -> str # returns URL of generated 3D site
E2.source: request I couldn't do yet: Can you build a 3d website for me ?
E2.note: replaced by the universal code block in v0.4

E3.title: Flexible Selector Block
E3.why: Handles pages where expected elements may be missing, reducing heal failures
E3.what: Adds a select_any block that tries multiple CSS selectors and returns the first successful match (or empty)
E3.risk: Minimal – only adds a utility function
E3.block_doc: select_any(html, selectors:list, all=False, attr=None) -> text or list of texts

E4.title: Safe Selector Block
E4.why: Prevents workflow failures when CSS selectors miss, reducing manual patches
E4.what: Adds a select_safe(html, css, all=false, attr=null) block that returns empty string if no match instead of error
E4.risk: Minimal – just adds a wrapper around existing select logic
E4.block_doc: select_safe(html, css, all=False, attr=None) -> str or list: returns matched text or empty if none
